messages:
Jordan Wells: Heads up — vendor AstraWave submitted invoice INV-2026-1122 for April bandwidth ($6,720.00) but did not include our PO. Vendor references 'AZ-992' in the email. Can we confirm?
Ava Rodriguez: @Jordan can you drop the invoice link? I'll check POs.
Jordan Wells: link -> https://files.redwood/test/invoices/INV-2026-1122.pdf 
AP Bot: Invoice INV-2026-1122 uploaded. Status: pending PO match.
Tom Nguyen: Searching PO system for AZ-992... nothing exact. We have PO-AZ-0992 from 2024 but shows closed.
Lina Gomez: Is this charge against the new edge project (cost center 5130)? If so PO-AZ-0992 was for a pilot and shouldn't apply.
Jordan Wells: Vendor email says service period 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30, and mentions contract ref AW-2025. No cost center on invoice.
Ava Rodriguez: Two paths: ask vendor to reissue with PO-ASTRA-2026 format, or create a retro PO with AP exception note. Preference: vendor reissue within 7 days.
Tom Nguyen: If vendor can't reissue we can do retro but need signoff from project owner. @Lina can you confirm validity for CC 5130?
Lina Gomez: Confirmed: bandwidth used for edge nodes in APAC, cost center 5130. I authorize exception if AP creates PO-INT-AW-2026-014 and marks as "retroPO".
Jordan Wells: OK I'll request vendor reissue and copy contracts. Sending now.
AP Bot: Exception request logged for INV-2026-1122.
Ava Rodriguez: Creating internal PO now to avoid payment hold if vendor delays.
AP Bot: PO created: PO-INT-AW-2026-014 (linked to INV-2026-1122).
Tom Nguyen: PO-INT-AW-2026-014 routed to Lina for approval.
Lina Gomez: Approved. :white_check_mark: Please proceed with payment.
AP Bot: Approval recorded. Invoice marked for payment on next AP run. Note to AP: vendor must include official PO on future invoices.
Jordan Wells: Vendor replied — they'll reissue with full PO and cost center in 3 business days. Keeping thread open until we receive it.
Ava Rodriguez: Thanks — I'll follow up if AP gets any exception audits.
Jordan Wells: Closing loop: payment processed on exception; tracking reissued invoice for vendor compliance.
AP Bot: Thread update: INV-2026-1122 status -> Paid (exception).
